directive: 目的、場所、人物、達成条件、報酬、時系列を正確に保って説明する。

entries.EN: The Trader ordered me to bring him the "Stone Blood" artifact, which is apparently special and different from the others - it's more radioactive and has got higher healing abilities than other similar artifacts. I was advised to search for it in the ravine with the anomalies.
entries.JA_current: The Trader ordered me to bring him the "Stone Blood" artifact, which is apparently special and different from the others - it's more radioactive and has got higher healing abilities than other similar artifacts. I was advised to search for it in the ravine with the anomalies.
entries.JA_new: 商人から、ほかのものとは違う特別なアーティファクト«ストーンブラッド»を持ってくるよう頼まれた。放射能が強いぶん、同種のアーティファクトより治癒効果も高いらしい。異常現象のある渓谷を探すといいそうだ。

entries.EN: Emergency - a group of rookies goofed up by shooting at a military helicopter, resulting in all of them getting wasted. Maybe somebody is still alive; a welfare check is needed.
entries.JA_current: Emergency - a group of rookies goofed up by shooting at a military helicopter, resulting in all of them getting wasted. Maybe somebody is still alive; a welfare check is needed.
entries.JA_new: 緊急事態だ。新人ストーカーの一団が軍のヘリを撃ってしまい、全員やられたらしい。まだ生きている者がいるかもしれない。様子を見に行こう。

entries.EN: Strelok's hideout needs to be checked for any signs of activity. Perhaps someone has settled down in there.
entries.JA_current: Strelok's hideout needs to be checked for any signs of activity. Perhaps someone has settled down in there.
entries.JA_new: ストレロクの隠れ家に、誰かが住み着いた形跡がないか調べる必要がある。

entries.EN: The scientist must be found and, if possible, saved. He is hiding somewhere near the entrance to X-18 down in the Dark Valley. Afterwards it needs to be established why the military designated the scientists as viable targets.
entries.JA_current: The scientist must be found and, if possible, saved. He is hiding somewhere near the entrance to X-18 down in the Dark Valley. Afterwards it needs to be established why the military designated the scientists as viable targets.
entries.JA_new: ダークバレーのX-18入口付近にいる科学者を見つけ、可能なら救出する。その後、軍が科学者を攻撃対象にした理由を突き止めよう。

entries.review_notes: 原文が「No description」のため、意味をそのまま「説明なし」とした。

entries.EN: Attention all stalkers! The "Duty" base is under attack. Help is needed and appreciated. Good reward is guaranteed!
entries.JA_current: Attention all stalkers! The "Duty" base is under attack. Help is needed and appreciated. Good reward is guaranteed!
entries.JA_new: ストーカー各位、デューティーの拠点が襲撃を受けている。助太刀求む。報酬は弾む！

entries.EN: I need to find some rookie swindler named Fedka, who robbed the trader Sidorovich, and find any evidence which could exonerate his unfortunate friend. According to the Outcast, Fedka disappeared without a trace in the area of a garbage dump to the north of the village.
entries.JA_current: I need to find some rookie swindler named Fedka, who robbed the trader Sidorovich, and find any evidence which could exonerate his unfortunate friend. According to the Outcast, Fedka disappeared without a trace in the area of a garbage dump to the north of the village.
entries.JA_new: シドロヴィッチを騙して盗みを働いた新人詐欺師、フェドカを見つけ、気の毒な仲間の疑いを晴らす証拠も探す。アウトキャストの話では、フェドカは村の北にあるゴミ捨て場のあたりで消息を絶ったらしい。

entries.EN: Word around town is that a group of unknown stalkers penetrated through the military checkpoint from the outside world some time ago. The Outcast, in gratitude for the help, told me that one of them got wasted and his body is by some fallen tree to the side of the checkpoint. Should sneak down there and search the body for anything interesting.
entries.JA_current: Word around town is that a group of unknown stalkers penetrated through the military checkpoint from the outside world some time ago. Should sneak down there and search the body for anything interesting.
entries.JA_new: しばらく前、正体不明のストーカー集団が外の世界から軍の検問所を抜けてゾーンに入ったという噂を聞いた。助けた礼に、アウトキャストが教えてくれた。仲間の一人がやられ、検問所脇の倒木のそばに遺体があるそうだ。何か持っていないか調べに行こう。

entries.EN: As it turned out, this group of stalkers who entered the Zone is also interested in finding Strelok. The current fate of the group is unknown, but I found a map with instructions for locating a hidden cache near the rail bridge outpost, somewhere in the buildings with the grain elevator. Perhaps this cache would reveal more, and assist me in my own search.\n\nThe cache location map is in your Diary.
entries.JA_current: As it turned out, this group of stalkers who entered the Zone is also interested in finding Strelok. Perhaps this cache would reveal more, and assist me in my own search.\n\nThe cache location map is in your Diary.
entries.JA_new: ゾーンに入ったストーカー集団も、ストレロクを探していたようだ。今どうなったのかは分からないが、線路橋の前哨地近く、穀物エレベーターの建物に隠し場所があるという地図を見つけた。中に手がかりがあれば、俺の捜索にも役立つかもしれない。\n\n隠し場所の地図は日記に入っている。

entries.EN: A note in the cache suggested the group would go to Agroprom to search for an alleged location of Strelok's own hideout. It was evident I'd have to find this hideout, and perhaps there I'd find this group of stalkers as well. The note suggests a stalker named Makhnovec has more detailed information on the location of this hideout.
entries.JA_current: A note in the cache suggested the group would go to Agroprom to search for an alleged location of Strelok's own hideout. It was evident I'd have to find this hideout, and perhaps there I'd find this group of stalkers as well. The note suggests a stalker named Makhnovec has more detailed information on the location of this hideout.
entries.JA_new: 隠し場所のメモによると、連中はストレロクの隠れ家を探しにアフロプロムへ向かったらしい。まずはその場所を見つけよう。連中にも会えるかもしれない。メモには、マフノヴィッツというストーカーが隠れ家の場所を詳しく知っているとある。

entries.EN: In Fedka's notebook, there is information that he sold Sidorovich's swag to a stalker named Vovan. The merchant said that Vovan most likely operates in the Dark Valley. I need to find this Vovan, persuade him to return the stolen items and return them to the Trader.
entries.JA_current: In Fedka's notebook, there is information that he sold Sidorovich's swag to a stalker named Vovan. The merchant said that Vovan most likely operates in the Dark Valley. I need to find this Vovan, persuade him to return the stolen items and return them to the Trader.
entries.JA_new: フェドカの手帳によれば、シドロヴィッチから盗んだ品をヴォヴァンというストーカーに売ったらしい。商人の話では、ヴォヴァンはダークバレーで活動している可能性が高い。彼を見つけ、盗品を返すよう説得して商人に届けよう。

entries.EN: An experienced stalker named Mentor, who is staying in the Rookie Village at the Cordon, needs help. I need to speak with him and decide if I could assist.
entries.JA_current: An experienced stalker named Mentor, who is staying in the Rookie Village at the Cordon, needs help. I need to speak with him and decide if I could assist.
entries.JA_new: コルドンの新人村にいるベテランストーカー、メンターが助けを求めている。話を聞いて、力を貸せるか決めよう。

entries.EN: The Seeker Mentor told me that a group of 17 of his comrades, having organized an expedition to the north, disappeared without a trace about a month ago when they inexplicably split up all over the Zone and vanished. Sightings confirmed: 2 each at Cordon, Agroprom, the Garbage, the Bar, the Wild Territory, the Dark Valley, Yantar and 3 in around the Army Warehouses. It is necessary to find information about the members of the Seeker expedition and uncover their fate.
entries.JA_current: The Seeker Mentor told me that a group of 17 of his comrades, having organized an expedition to the north, disappeared without a trace about a month ago when they inexplicably split up all over the Zone and vanished. Sightings confirmed: 2 each at Cordon, Agroprom, the Garbage, the Bar, the Wild Territory, the Dark Valley, Yantar and 3 in around the Army Warehouses. It is necessary to find information about the members of the Seeker expedition and uncover their fate.
entries.JA_new: シーカーのメンターによると、北への遠征に出た仲間17人が、ひと月ほど前に消息を絶った。何があったのか、ゾーンの各地に散り散りになったらしい。目撃情報は、コルドン、アフロプロム、ガーベジ、バー、荒廃領域、ダークバレー、ヤンターに各2人、軍事倉庫に3人。遠征隊の情報を集め、仲間たちの行方を突き止めよう。

entries.EN: Mentor asked me to find the body of a deceased stalker called Musician, and retrieve his guitar. According to Mentor, Musician died somewhere around the Cordon.
entries.JA_current: Mentor asked me to find the body of a deceased stalker called Musician, and retrieve his guitar. According to Mentor, Musician died somewhere around the Cordon.
entries.JA_new: メンターから、ミュージシャンというストーカーの遺体を見つけ、ギターを回収してほしいと頼まれた。コルドン周辺で亡くなったらしい。

entries.EN: According to Tolik, he hid a bottle of moonshine somewhere in the Rookie Village, but forgot where exactly.
entries.JA_current: According to Tolik, he hid a bottle of moonshine somewhere in the Rookie Village, but forgot where exactly.
entries.JA_new: トリクは新人村のどこかに密造酒を隠したが、場所を忘れてしまったらしい。

entries.EN: Veteran Lech Slon asked us to help him free his brother from military captivity. We need to talk to the commander of the checkpoint on the Cordon and, if possible, negotiate with him about the release of the prisoner.
entries.JA_current: Veteran Lech Slon asked us to help him free his brother from military captivity. We need to talk to the commander of the checkpoint on the Cordon and, if possible, negotiate with him about the release of the prisoner.
entries.JA_new: 古参ストーカーのレフ・スロンから、軍に捕らえられた弟の救出を頼まれた。コルドンの検問所で指揮官と話し、できれば捕虜を釈放するよう交渉しよう。
